Parse a raw search-engine export into pep_all via a dictionary

Source: R/parse-unified.R
parse_unified.Rd

The dictionary-driven counterpart of the built-in parse_*() loaders: applies the columns: renames, sets the Found_By constant, and derives the shared pep_all columns (Length_range, Nter/Cter, Log2Area, PeptideID, and optionally Length and a formatted Charge), then guards the result with the same validate_pep_all() schema check the built-in loaders use. Reuses compute_log2area() so zero Area maps to NA consistently with the other loaders.

Usage

parse_unified(input, dictionary, shortpep_range = c(8, 13))

Arguments

input

A raw per-sample table, row-bound across samples and tagged with Sample_fp (e.g. the output of read_custom_batch()).

dictionary

Either a path to a YAML dictionary or an already-loaded dictionary list (see read_dictionary()).

shortpep_range

Length-2 numeric c(min, max) window for Length_range.

Value

The input reshaped into pep_all long format.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dict <- system.file("extdata", "dictionaries", "fragpipe.yaml", package = "HowMaHiCo")
read_custom_batch("2_data/my_export", file = "psm.tsv", delim = "\t") |>
  parse_unified(dict, shortpep_range = c(8, 13))
} # }
